articles.title: 【人事世界】Clerks Award 新增 WFH 條款 – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 澳洲嘅工作機構決定喺文員嘅工作規則裡面加一條新規矩，等員工可以正式講想喺屋企做嘢，但老闘唔一定要應承。

levels.text: 澳洲嘅Fair Work Commission決定喺《Clerks Award》裡面加一條新規則，等做文員嗰啲人可以正式講想喺屋企做嘢。老闘唔一定要應承呢個請求，但如果之後老闘對嗰個人唔好，就要證明係因為生意，唔係因為佢提出咗呢件事。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission decided to add a new rule to the Clerks Award, allowing clerical workers to formally ask to work from home. The boss doesn't have to agree to this request, but if the boss later treats that person badly, they must prove it was for business reasons, not because the person raised this request.

levels.text: 澳洲嘅Fair Work Commission（FWC）喺2026年8月27日公布決定，話會喺《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》加多一條新clause 5A，等文員可以正式提出想喺屋企做嘢嘅request。不過，呢個唔等於員工有權一定要WFH，老闘仍然可以唔批准。如果員工提出request之後，好快就被人降職或者被dismiss，公司就要清楚證明係因為生意原因，唔係因為佢用咗呢個權利。因為呢個request係受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障嘅workplace right。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) announced a decision on 27 August 2026 that it will add a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, allowing clerical workers to formally make a request to work from home. However, this doesn't mean employees have an absolute right to WFH — bosses can still refuse. If an employee is demoted or dismissed soon after making the request, the company must clearly prove it was for business reasons, not because the employee exercised this right. This is because the request is a workplace right protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act.

levels.text: 根據澳洲Fair Work Commission（FWC）喺2026年8月27日公布嘅決定，佢哋建議喺《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》新增clause 5A，為受呢個award覆蓋嘅員工設立一個正式嘅work-from-home request機制。不過而家只係draft determination，最終條文仲要經過consultation，意見提交期限係2026年9月17日。FWC嘅Full Bench冇接受工會提出「員工request就應該自動獲批」呢個做法，佀話現有證據唔足夠支持一個強制性嘅監管介入，亦冇證據顯示僱主經常以任意或者歧視性理由拒絕request。換句話講，員工有正式request機制，但唔等於有『work from home嘅權利』。新clause 5A令僱主同員工可以透過協議調整部分僵化嘅award requirements，例如工作時間安排同埋meal and rest breaks，以配合已經存在嘅WFH安排。最重要嘅係，按clause 5A提出嘅request會受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障，即係僱主唔可以因為員工用咗呢個workplace right而採取adverse action，例如降職或者dismiss佢。
levels.text_en: According to a decision announced by Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) on 27 August 2026, they propose adding a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees covered by this award. However, this is currently only a draft determination — the final wording still needs to go through consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. The FWC's Full Bench did not accept the union's proposal that an employee's request should be automatically approved, stating that existing evidence is insufficient to support mandatory regulatory intervention, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse requests for arbitrary or discriminatory reasons. In other words, employees now have a formal request mechanism, but this does not equal a 'right to work from home'. The new clause 5A allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some of the award's rigid requirements — such as working hours arrangements and meal and rest breaks — to accommodate existing WFH arrangements. Most importantly, requests made under clause 5A will be protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, meaning employers cannot take adverse action against an employee — such as demotion or dismissal — because the employee exercised this workplace right.

levels.text: 澳洲公平工作委員會（Fair Work Commission，簡稱FWC）在2026年8月27日公布一項決定，建議在《文員私營行業獎項2020》（Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020）中新增條款5A，為員工設立正式的在家工作申請機制。目前這只是草案，最終內容還需經過諮詢，意見提交期限為2026年9月17日。委員會的全席審裁組並沒有接受工會提出的「申請即應獲批」建議，理由是現有證據不足以支持強制性規管，也沒有證據顯示僱主普遍以不合理理由拒絕申請。也就是說，員工只是有了正式申請的權利，並非自動獲得在家工作的權利。新條款讓僱主與員工可以透過協議調整部分僵化的規定，例如工作時間和用膳休息時間，以配合已有的在家工作安排。更重要的是，根據新條款提出的申請，將受《公平工作法》第340條保障，僱主不可以因員工行使這項權利而作出不利對待，例如降職或解僱。因此，僱主拒絕申請本身未必有問題，但之後如何處理，才是關鍵。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) announced a decision on 27 August 2026 proposing to add a new clause 5A to the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees. Currently this is only a draft, and the final content still needs to go through consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. The Commission's Full Bench did not accept the union's proposal that 'a request should be approved automatically', on the grounds that existing evidence is insufficient to support mandatory regulation, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse requests for unreasonable reasons. In other words, employees only gain the right to make a formal request, not an automatic right to work from home. The new clause allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some rigid provisions, such as working hours and meal/rest breaks, to fit existing work-from-home arrangements. More importantly, requests made under the new clause will be protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, and employers cannot take adverse action — such as demotion or dismissal — against an employee for exercising this right. Therefore, refusing a request itself may not be a problem, but how it is handled afterward is the key issue.

levels.text: 先旨聲明：呢次 Fair Work Commission（FWC）唔係修改《Fair Work Act》本身，而係決定修改《Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020》。FWC喺2026年8月27日公布決定，提出新增 clause 5A，為受 Clerks Award 覆蓋嘅員工建立一個正式嘅working-from-home request機制。不過，截至目前， FWC只係公布決定及draft determination， 最終條文仍然要經過drafting consultation， 相關意見提交期限係2026年9月17日。 FWC今次並冇接受工會提出嘅做法，即係員工提出WFH request之後，原則上應該獲得批准。Full Bench（審理小組）認為， 現有證據唔足以支持需要一個更加廣泛、強制性嘅監管介入， 亦冇證據顯示僱主普遍以任意、武斷或者歧視性理由拒絕WFH request。換句話講，員工有正式request mechanism，但唔等於有一個「right to work from home」。 呢個分別對僱主非常重要。 新clause 5A嘅核心，其實係令僱主同員工可以透過協議， 調整部分原本比較僵化嘅Award requirements，以配合已經存在嘅WFH arrangement。包括continuous ordinary hours、部分工作時間安排，以及meal and rest breaks等條款。換句話講，FWC唔係單純話「 可以喺屋企做嘢」， 而係承認傳統Award入面部分工作時間規則， 未必完全適合現代工作模式。 對員工而言，最大改變係：WFH request唔再只係公司policy或者manager discretion之下嘅informal conversation，而會成為Award framework入面一個正式機制。更加重要嘅係， FWC表示按照clause 5A提出嘅request會構成一項受《Fair Work Act》section 340保障嘅workplace right，而section 340禁止僱主因為員工擁有或者行使workplace right而採取adverse action。 呢一點可能先係今次改變對HR最值得留意嘅地方。 例如，一名員工正式提出WFH request，僱主原則上仍然可以唔同意。 但如果之後員工突然被降職、減少工作機會、 受到不合理performance management，甚至被dismiss， 而時間上又同request非常接近， 公司就需要非常清楚咁證明相關決定係基於真正嘅business reasons，而唔係因為員工行使咗一項workplace right。 因此，拒絕request本身未必係問題， 但點樣處理request，以及之後發生乜嘢
levels.text_en: First, to clarify: this time the Fair Work Commission (FWC) is not amending the Fair Work Act itself, but has decided to amend the Clerks—Private Sector Award 2020. The FWC announced its decision on 27 August 2026, proposing to add a new clause 5A, establishing a formal work-from-home request mechanism for employees covered by the Clerks Award. However, as of now, the FWC has only published the decision and a draft determination — the final wording still needs to go through drafting consultation, with submissions due by 17 September 2026. This time, the FWC did not accept the union's proposal that once an employee makes a WFH request, it should in principle be approved. The Full Bench considered that existing evidence is insufficient to support the need for broader, mandatory regulatory intervention, and there is no evidence that employers commonly refuse WFH requests for arbitrary or discriminatory reasons. In other words, employees have a formal request mechanism, but this does not equal a 'right to work from home'. This distinction is very important for employers. The core of the new clause 5A is that it allows employers and employees to agree to adjust some of the award's originally rigid requirements to fit existing WFH arrangements — including continuous ordinary hours, some working hour arrangements, and meal and rest break provisions. In other words, the FWC is not simply saying 'you can work from home', but is acknowledging that some working hour rules in the traditional award may not fully suit modern work patterns. For employees, the biggest change is: a WFH request is no longer just an informal conversation subject to company policy or manager discretion, but becomes a formal mechanism within the award framework. More importantly, the FWC states that a request made under clause 5A constitutes a workplace right protected under section 340 of the Fair Work Act, and section 340 prohibits employers from taking adverse action against an employee because the employee has or exercises a workplace right. This point may be the most noteworthy aspect of this change for HR. For example, an employee formally makes a WFH request, and the employer can in principle still refuse. But if the employee is subsequently suddenly demoted, given fewer work opportunities, subjected to unreasonable performance management, or even dismissed — and the timing is very close to the request — the company will need to very clearly prove that the relevant decision was based on genuine business reasons, not because the employee exercised a workplace right. Therefore, refusing a request itself may not be the problem — but how the request is handled, and what happens afterward...

articles.summary_en: An HR-focused commentary explains a 2026 decision by Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) to add a new work-from-home request clause to the Clerks—Private Sector Award, and what it means for employers and employees.

articles.title: 台東旅遊︳被忽略的台東　6處秘景比宮崎峻的吉卜力動畫世界更美
articles.summary: 呢篇文介紹台東六個好靚但好少人知嘅景點，個個都靚到好似動畫世界咁夢幻。

levels.text: 台東有六個好靚嘅地方，好少人知。成功鎮有間得意嘅卡片教堂，好似聖誕卡咁得意。東河鎮有個靚巴士站，用石頭同木整成，好似會見到龍貓咁。仲有間咖啡室，夜晚啲燈好靚，好似樹洞咁神秘。呢啲地方全部都好靚，好似動畫世界咁夢幻！
levels.text_en: Taitung has six very beautiful places that few people know about. Chenggong Town has a cute 'card church' that looks like a Christmas card. Donghe Town has a pretty bus stop made of stone and wood that looks like you might see Totoro there. There's also a coffee shop where the lights look beautiful at night, mysterious like a tree hollow. All these places are beautiful, like a dreamy animated world!

levels.text: 台東有六個好少人知嘅靚景點。第一個係成功鎮嘅卡片教堂，本身係間好舊嘅木教堂，後來因為打風壞咗，重建之後變得好得意，好似聖誕卡上面嘅教堂咁。第二個係東河鎮嘅知路橋公車站，用石頭同木整成，好多人話喺嗰度等車好似會見到龍貓。第三個係隆昌部落嘅「我在玩-玩冰箱」，賣早午餐，要預約先食到。第四個係加路蘭海岸，有好多藝術裝置，仲有間用漂流木整嘅小屋。第五個係Cheela小屋咖啡館，夜晚啲燈好靚，好似神秘嘅樹洞咁。呢啲地方全部都好靚，好似宮崎駿嘅動畫世界咁夢幻。
levels.text_en: Taitung has six beautiful scenic spots that few people know about. The first is the Card Church in Chenggong Town, originally a very old wooden church that was damaged by a typhoon and later rebuilt to become cute, like a church printed on a Christmas card. The second is the Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town, made of stone and wood — many people say waiting for the bus there feels like you might see Totoro. The third is 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge' in Longchang Tribal Village, which sells brunch but requires reservations to eat there. The fourth is Jialulan Coast, which has many art installations, including a small hut made of driftwood. The fifth is Cheela Cabin Café, where the lights at night look beautiful, like a mysterious tree hollow. All these places are beautiful, like a dreamy world from a Miyazaki animation.

levels.text: 台東位於海岸山脈同太平洋之間，有唔少鮮為人知嘅靚景。成功鎮宜灣部落嘅「卡片教堂」，原本係普通木教堂，1974年因颱風損毀，經建築師賴明德重建後，變成色彩繽紛、充滿歐洲鄉村風格嘅小教堂，吸引唔少導演取景。東河鎮嘅知路橋公車站，本來只係普通候車站，經人整理後用天然石牆同廢棄木料打造，背靠老檜木，被譽為全台最美候車亭。附近隆昌部落有間隱世小店「我在玩-玩冰箱」，供應限量早午餐，結合木工體驗同在地農產品。台東市嘅加路蘭海岸，原本係廢棄土置場，經整頓後變成結合藝術同生態嘅遊憩區，其中藝術家伊祐‧噶照用漂流木整嘅小屋最矚目。最後，Cheela小屋咖啡館入夜後燈火透過植物滲出，好似龍貓樹洞咁神秘夢幻，令人聯想起宮崎駿嘅吉卜力動畫世界。
levels.text_en: Taitung, located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, has many beautiful yet little-known scenic spots. The 'Card Church' in Yiwan Tribal Village, Chenggong Town, was originally an ordinary wooden church damaged by a typhoon in 1974. After being rebuilt by architect Lai Mingde, it became a colorful little church full of European countryside style, attracting many film directors to shoot there. The Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town was originally just an ordinary bus stop, but after being renovated using natural stone walls and discarded wood, and backed by an old cypress tree, it is now praised as the most beautiful bus shelter in Taiwan. Nearby in Longchang Tribal Village is a hidden little shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' offering limited brunch combined with woodworking experiences and local farm produce. Jialulan Coast in Taitung City was originally an abandoned dumping ground for soil, but after renovation it became a recreational area combining art and ecology, with the driftwood hut made by artist Iyo Kacaw being the most eye-catching feature. Finally, at Cheela Cabin Café, the lights that leak through plants at night look as mysterious and dreamy as Totoro's tree hollow, reminiscent of Miyazaki's Studio Ghibli animated world.

levels.text: 台東位於海岸山脈與太平洋之間，有六個鮮為人知的美麗景點。成功鎮的宜灣部落有一座「卡片教堂」，原本是普通木造教堂，1974年被颱風摧毀，後由建築師賴明德重建，變成色彩繽紛、風格獨特的小教堂。東河鎮的知路橋公車站，本來只是簡陋站牌，經人整理後用石頭與木料打造，被稱為全台最美候車亭。附近的隆昌部落有間隱世小店「我在玩-玩冰箱」，只供應限量早午餐，需預約才能享用。台東市的加路蘭海岸，原是廢棄土地，現已改建成結合藝術與生態的休憩區，設有多件藝術裝置，其中一間漂流木小屋最受歡迎。晚上的Cheela小屋咖啡館，燈光透過植物灑出，氣氛神秘夢幻。這些景點的美麗程度，堪比宮崎駿吉卜力動畫的世界。
levels.text_en: Located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, Taitung has six little-known and beautiful scenic spots. The 'Card Church' in Yiwan Tribal Village, Chenggong Town, was originally an ordinary wooden church, destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, then rebuilt by architect Lai Mingde into a colorful, uniquely styled small church. The Zhilu Bridge bus stop in Donghe Town was originally just a simple sign, but after renovation using stone and wood, it became known as the most beautiful bus shelter in Taiwan. Nearby in Longchang Tribal Village is a hidden shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' which only offers limited brunch and requires reservations. Jialulan Coast in Taitung City was originally abandoned land, now transformed into a recreational area combining art and ecology, featuring multiple art installations, with one driftwood hut being especially popular. At night, Cheela Cabin Café's lights spill out through the plants, creating a mysterious, dreamy atmosphere. The beauty of these spots rivals the world of Miyazaki's Studio Ghibli animations.

levels.text: 1. 成功鎮：宜灣卡片教堂 介於海岸山脈與太平洋之間的台東，造就了許多不可思議的天然美景，在大自然相伴之下來首先抵達台東成功鎮。在小鎮北邊有個遺世獨立的「宜灣部落」，部落裡藏着一座超級逗趣的小教堂，名字就叫「卡片教堂」。卡片教堂本名叫宜灣長老教會，原本是樸素普通的木造屋，但因為老建築在1974年毀於颱風，之後在賴明德建築師的手下重建。走歐洲鄉村風的卡片教堂，從外牆到內部有着活潑圖騰與色彩點綴，就像復古聖誕卡片上印的Q版教堂，可愛到令人想撲上去，也吸引許多導演前來取景！ 2. 東河鎮：知路橋公車站 「希望時間暫停在這一刻，充滿魔法的地方。」在網路上有着如此評語的知路橋公車站，位在舊台11線的知路橋站旁，為台東擁有「最美的候車亭」之稱的公車站牌，是前往東河鄉買肉包時，必定要駐足的當地名景。 知路橋原本只是不起眼的公車招呼站，一支招牌用輪胎灌漿水泥插着而已，但在兩年多前由「無心巖」創辦人租下旁邊土地作為友善農作分享平台，才順便整理出供人免費使用的候車亭。利用天然石牆以及廢棄木料打造候車亭，背後倚着的駁坎小坵生長着巨大的老檜木，幾乎被自然包覆的場景，更顯出人類的渺小。 儘管無心巖已經退場，但留下空間遺跡仍舊迷人，吸引許多人遠道前來等公車，在霧色迷離的清晨與向晚時分，總是懷抱一絲希望，搞不好可以偶遇龍貓呢！ 3. 東河鎮：我在玩-玩冰箱 轉進阿美族傳統製陶聚落的隆昌部落，在這裡有間被網友譽為「全台最美路邊攤」的小店，用茅草屋頂、漂流木、熱帶植物構築的街角空間，不拘小節的自然風情，簡直「鬆」到不行！ 店名口語而隨性的「我在玩-玩冰箱」，是當地人才知的隱藏版早午餐店，同時也結合木工體驗以及在地小農產品，每日極限量供應的餐點，若沒有事先預約，根本沒機會吃到。我在玩-玩冰箱以「豐盛玩美」為概念，最令人驚豔的就是用天然木板集合擺盤料理的多人共享早午餐，那粗獷卻繽紛有如花藝創作的呈現手法，展現出台東海岸部落小農食材的多樣性，同時也呼應了追求天然原味的飲食概念，以及追求無拘無束的自由生活態度。 4. 台東市：加路蘭海岸 遺世獨立的加路蘭海岸，是距離台東市區不太遠，開車往北走僅需15分鐘左右，渡過卑南溪之後，就能抵達的靜好海岸。 加路蘭海岸位在小野柳風景區附近，這裡原本是廢棄土置場，為空軍建設志航基地機場所用，如今在東海岸國家風景區管理處的整頓下，結合藝術與生態工法打造為自然遊憩區。 沿着海岸散策，可見藝術家創作裝置，例如「類窗櫺」、「日昇之舞」、「風車組」、「哭泣的露珠」等，最深受吸引的，莫過於原住民藝術家伊祐‧噶照（Iyo Kacaw）用漂流木做出繭型小屋，這個取名叫「在海邊看書，好嗎? 」的小屋，與大海形呼應形成奇幻的風景，簡直就像小煤炭精靈的巢！ 5. 台東市：Cheela小屋咖啡館 夜裡，Cheela小屋點燃微渺燈火，光滲透過重重植物的包圍，像神秘的龍貓樹洞，指引着人們往深
levels.text_en: 1. Chenggong Town: Yiwan Card Church. Located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, Taitung is blessed with many incredible natural landscapes. We first arrive at Chenggong Town in Taitung. On the north side of the town lies the secluded 'Yiwan Tribal Village,' hiding within it a super charming little church called the 'Card Church.' Its formal name is the Yiwan Presbyterian Church. It was originally a plain, ordinary wooden building, but after the old structure was destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, it was rebuilt under architect Lai Mingde. With its European countryside style, the Card Church is decorated from its outer walls to its interior with lively patterns and colors, looking just like the cute, chibi-style church printed on a vintage Christmas card — so adorable that people want to run up and hug it! It has also attracted many film directors to shoot scenes there. 2. Donghe Town: Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop. Online, this bus stop has been described as 'a magical place where you wish time would stand still.' Located beside the old Zhilu Bridge Station on the former Provincial Highway 11, it is known as Taitung's 'most beautiful bus shelter' and is a must-stop local landmark on the way to buy meat buns in Donghe Township. Zhilu Bridge was originally just an unremarkable bus stop — a sign stuck into a tire filled with cement. But more than two years ago, the founder of 'Wuxin Yan' rented the adjacent land to create a friendly farming-sharing platform, and in the process tidied up the area into a free-to-use bus shelter. Built using natural stone walls and discarded wood, the shelter stands with its back against a small embankment where a giant old cypress tree grows — the scene almost entirely enveloped by nature, highlighting how small humans are by comparison. Although Wuxin Yan has since closed, the remaining space is still charming, drawing many people from afar to wait for the bus there. In the misty early mornings and evenings, people always hold a faint hope that they might just encounter Totoro! 3. Donghe Town: 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge.' Turning into Longchang Tribal Village, a traditional Amis pottery-making community, there is a small shop that netizens have called 'the most beautiful roadside stall in Taiwan.' Built with a thatched roof, driftwood, and tropical plants, this relaxed street-corner space has an unpretentious, natural charm that is utterly laid-back! With its casual, colloquial name 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' this is a hidden brunch spot known only to locals, also combining woodworking experiences with local small-farm produce. The extremely limited daily meals are impossible to get without a reservation. Built around the concept of 'abundant beauty,' the shop's most stunning offering is a shared brunch for multiple people, artfully arranged on natural wooden boards. This rough yet colorful presentation, like a floral art creation, showcases the diversity of ingredients from Taitung's coastal tribal small farms, while also reflecting a dining philosophy that pursues natural, original flavors and an unrestrained, free lifestyle. 4. Taitung City: Jialulan Coast. The secluded Jialulan Coast is not far from downtown Taitung — only about a 15-minute drive north, crossing the Beinan River, to reach this tranquil coastline. Jialulan Coast is located near the Xiaoyeliu Scenic Area. It was originally an abandoned soil dumping site used for the construction of the Air Force's Zhihang Base airport. Now, under the management of the East Coast National Scenic Area Administration, it has been transformed into a natural recreational area combining art and ecological engineering. Strolling along the coast, you can see artistic installations such as 'Quasi-Window Lattice,' 'Dance of the Rising Sun,' 'Windmill Set,' and 'Weeping Dewdrop.' The most captivating of all is the cocoon-shaped driftwood hut made by Indigenous artist Iyo Kacaw. Named 'Reading by the Sea, Shall We?', this hut echoes the ocean to form a fantastical scene, just like the nest of a little soot sprite! 5. Taitung City: Cheela Cabin Café. articles.summary_en: This article is a travel piece introducing six lesser-known scenic spots in Taitung, Taiwan, located between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, comparing their whimsical, dreamlike beauty to Hayao Miyazaki's Studio Ghibli animated worlds.

articles.summary: 日本福井縣落好大雨，天氣部門發咗最高級大雨警報，叫幾十萬人要小心安全。

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日落好大雨，天氣部門一度發出最高級嘅大雨警報，叫福井市、大野市、同勝山市嘅四十萬人要小心安全。福井縣有地方冇咗，仲有車困喺水裡面。坂井市有個女人跌親受傷。
levels.text_en: It rained very heavily in Fukui Prefecture, Japan yesterday. The weather department at one point issued the highest-level heavy rain warning, telling the 400,000 people in Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City to be careful and stay safe. Some places in Fukui Prefecture had land collapse, and a car got stuck in water. In Sakai City, a woman fell and got hurt.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日落咗好大嘅雨，氣象部門一度向福井市、大野市、勝山市發出最高級別嘅大雨特別警報，叫呢三個市、總共四十萬居民要確保自己安全。福井縣至少發生咗四宗地質災害，有車輛被困喺水浸嘅道路上。喺坂井市，有一位女士喺水浸嘅路上跌倒受傷。數據話，勝山市、福井市同坂井市嘅二十四小時雨量都超過三百毫米，大野市嘅雨量亦超過二百五十毫米，係當地有記錄以嚟最高嘅，預計暴雨會持續到今日中午。
levels.text_en: Heavy rain fell in Fukui Prefecture, Japan yesterday. The meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City, telling the 400,000 residents of these three cities to ensure their safety. At least four geological disasters occurred in Fukui Prefecture, with vehicles trapped on flooded roads. In Sakai City, a woman fell and was injured on a flooded road. Data show that the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm, while Ono City's rainfall exceeded 250mm — the highest on record locally. The heavy rain is expected to continue until noon today.

levels.text: 日本福井縣昨日遭遇暴雨侵襲，當地氣象部門一度向福井市、大野市及勝山市發出最高級別嘅大雨特別警報，呼籲呢三個市合共四十萬名居民必須確保自身安全。福井縣境內至少發生四宗地質災害，其中有車輛被困於水浸道路上，情況相當危險。喺坂井市，一名女子喺水浸嘅道路上跌倒受傷，需要送院治理。根據數據顯示，勝山市、福井市同坂井市嘅二十四小時雨量均超過三百毫米，而大野市嘅雨量亦超過二百五十毫米，呢啲數字都係當地有記錄以嚟嘅最高紀錄。當局預計呢場暴雨最少會持續至今日中午，提醒居民仍要提高警覺，密切留意天氣變化。
levels.text_en: Fukui Prefecture in Japan was hit by heavy rain yesterday. The local meteorological department at one point issued the highest-level special heavy rain warning for Fukui City, Ono City, and Katsuyama City, calling on the 400,000 residents of these three cities to ensure their own safety. At least four geological disasters occurred within Fukui Prefecture, including vehicles trapped on flooded roads, a rather dangerous situation. In Sakai City, a woman fell on a flooded road and was injured, requiring hospital treatment. According to data, the 24-hour rainfall in Katsuyama, Fukui, and Sakai cities all exceeded 300mm, while Ono City's rainfall also exceeded 250mm — all the highest figures on local record. Authorities expect this heavy rain to continue at least until noon today, and remind residents to stay alert and closely monitor changes in the weather.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】「開筆禮」是中國傳統嗎？
articles.summary: 作者話而家啲廟宇搞嘅「開筆禮」其實唔係真正嘅中國舊傳統，只係抄大陸呢十幾年先興出嚟嘅玩法。

levels.text: 黃大仙祠搞咗個「開筆禮」，一班細路著返儒服，拜孔子，寫字，仲用硃砂喺額頭度點一點。有人話呢個係中國舊時嘅傳統，不過作者話唔係，因為呢個做法係抄返大陸呢十幾年先興出嚟嘅嘢，同以前真正嘅開筆禮好唔同。
levels.text_en: Wong Tai Sin Temple held an 'Opening the Pen' ceremony where a group of kids wore Confucian robes, bowed to Confucius, wrote characters, and had a dot of cinnabar placed on their foreheads. Some people said this was an old Chinese tradition, but the author says it isn't — this practice was actually copied from mainland China only in the last decade or so, and is very different from the real old-style 'opening the pen' ceremony.

levels.text: 黃大仙祠舉行「開筆禮」，大約150個準備升小一嘅學童著儒服，拜孔子，寫「人」字，仲畀人用硃砂喺眉心度點一點，話係「開智」。立法會議員劉智鵬喺場致辭，話想香港做中外文化交流中心，要全民識寫毛筆字先算有底蘊。作者就話呢個所謂開筆禮其實唔係真正嘅中國傳統，只係抄返大陸近十幾年先興起嘅玩法，同舊時私塾嘅開筆禮好唔同，擺埋去而家嘅西式教育度，睇落幾矯情。
levels.text_en: Wong Tai Sin Temple held an 'Opening the Pen' ceremony where about 150 children about to start Primary One wore Confucian robes, bowed to Confucius, wrote the character '人' (person), and had cinnabar dotted on their foreheads by someone, said to represent 'opening wisdom.' Legislative Council member Liu Zhipeng gave a speech at the event, saying he wants Hong Kong to become a center of Chinese-foreign cultural exchange, and that everyone needs to know how to write with a brush for there to be real cultural substance. The author says this so-called 'opening the pen' ceremony isn't actually a genuine Chinese tradition — it's just a practice copied from mainland China that has become popular only in the last decade or so, very different from the old private school 'opening the pen' ceremony, and applying it to today's Western-style education system looks rather affected.

levels.text: 黃大仙祠喺8月23日搞咗個「萬世師表孔聖先師啟蒙開筆禮日」，大約150個準備升小一嘅學童著儒服，參加「擊鼓明志」、拜孔子、寫「人」字，同埋畀嗇色園主席黎澤森用硃砂喺眉心度逐個點痣，寓意「開智」。立法會議員兼歷史學者劉智鵬到場致辭，話要令香港成為中外文化交流中心，就要全民掌握中華文化嘅底蘊，市民識執毛筆寫幾個靚字先算有底蘊。作者就質疑呢個所謂「開筆禮」是否真正嘅中國傳統，佢話呢種做法其實係抄返大陸近十幾年先興起嘅玩法，同古代私塾入學禮唔同，將塾學儀式硬套喺而家嘅西式教育體系度，反而顯得矯情。作者仲引用王齊樂《香港中文教育發展史》入面記載嘅舊式入學禮做比較，指出真正嘅傳統儀式包含拜孔聖像、老師點額、描紅、講吉祥話等多個步驟，同而家嘅版本差好遠。
levels.text_en: On August 23, Wong Tai Sin Temple held the 'Confucius Enlightenment Opening-the-Pen Ceremony Day.' About 150 children about to start Primary One wore Confucian robes and took part in 'drumming to declare intent,' bowing to Confucius, writing the character '人' (person), and having Sik Sik Yuen chairman Lai Chak-sum dot cinnabar on each child's forehead one by one, symbolizing 'opening wisdom.' Legislative Council member and historian Liu Zhipeng attended and gave a speech, saying that for Hong Kong to become a center of Chinese-foreign cultural exchange, everyone needs to grasp the substance of Chinese culture — citizens should be able to write a few decent characters with a writing brush for there to be real cultural substance. The author questions whether this so-called 'opening the pen' ceremony is really a genuine Chinese tradition. He says this practice is actually copied from a trend that has only become popular in mainland China in the last decade or so, different from the old private-school enrollment ceremonies of ancient times; forcibly applying an old private-school ritual to today's Western-style education system instead comes across as affected. The author also cites the old-style enrollment ceremony recorded in Wong Chai-lok's 'History of the Development of Chinese Education in Hong Kong' for comparison, pointing out that the genuine traditional ceremony included multiple steps such as bowing to a portrait of Confucius, the teacher dotting the forehead, tracing red characters, and saying auspicious words — very different from today's version.

levels.text: 黃大仙祠在8月23日舉辦「開筆禮」，約150名準小一學童穿儒服，參拜孔子，並由嗇色園主席黎澤森用硃砂為他們點額，象徵「開智」。立法會議員劉智鵬出席致辭，指香港要成為中外文化交流中心，市民必須懂得書寫毛筆字才算有文化底蘊。作者馮睎乾則認為，這個「開筆禮」並非真正的中國傳統，而是近十幾年大陸才流行的做法，與古代私塾的入學禮不同。他引用王齊樂所著《香港中文教育發展史》中記載的舊式入學禮，說明傳統儀式包括拜孔聖像、老師點額、描紅、講吉祥話等步驟，與現今版本相差甚遠，並批評把塾學儀式搬到西式教育體系顯得矯情。
levels.text_en: On August 23, Wong Tai Sin Temple held an 'Opening the Pen' ceremony. About 150 children about to start Primary One wore Confucian robes, bowed to Confucius, and had Sik Sik Yuen chairman Lai Chak-sum dot cinnabar on their foreheads, symbolizing 'opening wisdom.' Legislative Council member Liu Zhipeng attended and gave a speech, saying that for Hong Kong to become a center of Chinese-foreign cultural exchange, citizens must know how to write with a brush for there to be real cultural substance. The author, Fung Hei-kin, argues that this 'opening the pen' ceremony is not actually a genuine Chinese tradition, but rather a practice that has only become popular in mainland China in the last decade or so, different from the enrollment ceremonies of ancient private schools. He cites the old-style enrollment ceremony recorded in Wong Chai-lok's book 'History of the Development of Chinese Education in Hong Kong,' explaining that the traditional ceremony included steps such as bowing to a portrait of Confucius, the teacher dotting the forehead, tracing red characters, and speaking auspicious words — quite different from today's version — and criticizes the transplanting of an old private-school ritual into today's Western-style education system as coming across as affected.

levels.text: 近日媒體報道黃大仙祠舉行「開筆禮」，儀式包括以硃砂為學童點額，有讀者問我這種儀式是否真的屬於古代「開筆禮」。翻查相關報道，如有線新聞〈黃大仙祠開筆禮｜150 學童穿儒服、點硃砂 劉智鵬倡全民掌握中華文化命脈〉、星島頭條〈嗇色園黃大仙祠舉辦開筆禮 150 名準小一學子齊穿儒服禮拜孔子、點硃砂〉等，不禁失笑。 8月23日，黃大仙祠舉行「萬世師表孔聖先師啟蒙開筆禮日」。星島頭條言之鑿鑿說：「『開筆禮』為古代人生四禮之一，象徵少兒啟蒙、開始識字習禮的重要傳統。」當天約150個準備升讀小一的學童身穿儒服參加，儀式包括「擊鼓明志」、參拜孔子、執筆寫「人」字，並接受硃砂點痣——嗇色園董事會主席黎澤森以硃砂逐一為學童「點痣」，寓意為「開智」。 是日還有位貴賓致辭，就是立法會議員兼歷史學者劉智鵬。據《星島》報道，劉說要將香港發展成中外文化交流中心，必先讓全民掌握中華文化命脈，「早幾年被國家委派的任務，就是香港要作為中外文化交流中心，我馬上提出不能只交流，要有底蘊才行。若香港市民能人人拿起毛筆，會寫幾個像樣的字，這個就是我們中外文化交流底蘊。」 那麼這「開筆禮」及劉智鵬又展示了多少中華文化「底蘊」呢？且讓我先答讀者提問：儀式是否符合中國傳統的開筆禮？事實上，黃大仙祠這個所謂開筆禮儀式，不過是複製近十多年大陸人的玩法；從前中國入學儀式，不見得真是這樣做，而且那是塾學禮儀，移植到今天的西式教育體系，只覺矯情。關於傳統儀式的實況，我年紀還不夠老，沒趕得上見證舊時代，相關文獻記錄亦不常見。 以我所知，最可信及詳盡的舊式入學禮，載於王齊樂《香港中文教育發展史》。二十世紀初，飲譽港澳的塾師陳子褒（1862-1922）曾於堅道31號辦學塾，受業於陳的何文樂在1971年向王齊樂口述當年私塾入學禮過程。書中所錄如下，資料十分珍貴： 1）在孔聖像前，燃點香燭。 2）老師先拜聖像，並稟告開學兒童的姓名、年齡及籍貫等。 3）學童跪拜聖像，再拜蒙師。 4）老師以筆蘸朱砂，為學童點額，在眉心處點上一紅點，以示為學童啟蒙，將其點醒的意思。 5）將糯米糕餅一塊，放在書枱之坐椅上，用紙隔着，使學童略一坐下，以示學童將時時不離開書桌坐椅，勤力讀書的意思。 6）老師從書枱上的紅皮夾內，取出《三字經》一本，用紅筆圈上前數句及後數句；即「人之初，性本善，性相近，習相遠。」，「揚名聲，顯父母，光於前，垂於後。」及「我教子，惟一經。」等幾句，並叫學童隨聲朗讀一遍。 7） 老師教學童開筆。書枱上的筆墨盤，放有文房四寶（紙、墨、筆、硯）及葱蒜各一棵，老師握着學童的手，教寫已預備好的一頁紅朱字：「上大人孔乙己化三千七十士」，這稱為「描紅」。 8） 由老師向學童講幾句吉祥語，大致為祝頌的話，普通都是說四句的多。說過吉祥語後，儀式便告完成。 9）將生果餅食等分給同學及親友等享用。 10）學童提着燃㸃好的燈籠，上面寫有「吉星拱照」四個
levels.text_en: Recently the media reported that Wong Tai Sin Temple held an 'Opening the Pen' ceremony, which included dotting cinnabar on children's foreheads. A reader asked me whether this ceremony really counts as the ancient 'opening the pen' ritual. Looking into the relevant reports — such as Cable News's 'Wong Tai Sin Temple Opening-the-Pen Ceremony: 150 children wear Confucian robes, get dotted with cinnabar; Liu Zhipeng proposes that all citizens grasp the lifeline of Chinese culture' and Sing Tao Headline's 'Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple holds Opening-the-Pen Ceremony: 150 soon-to-be Primary One students wear Confucian robes together to worship Confucius and get dotted with cinnabar' — I couldn't help laughing. On August 23, Wong Tai Sin Temple held the 'Confucius Enlightenment Opening-the-Pen Ceremony Day.' Sing Tao Headline stated categorically: '"Opening the pen" is one of the four great rites of ancient life, symbolizing the important tradition of children's enlightenment and beginning to learn characters and rites.' That day, about 150 children about to start Primary One wore Confucian robes and took part in the ceremony, which included 'drumming to declare intent,' bowing to Confucius, writing the character '人' (person) with a brush, and receiving a cinnabar dot — Sik Sik Yuen board chairman Lai Chak-sum personally dotted cinnabar on each child, symbolizing 'opening wisdom.' There was also a distinguished guest who gave a speech that day: Legislative Council member and historian Liu Zhipeng. According to Sing Tao, Liu said that to develop Hong Kong into a center of Chinese-foreign cultural exchange, all citizens must first grasp the lifeline of Chinese culture: 'A task assigned by the state a few years ago was that Hong Kong should serve as a center of Chinese-foreign cultural exchange. I immediately said we can't just have exchange — we need substance. If every Hong Kong citizen could pick up a writing brush and write a few decent characters, that would be our substance for Chinese-foreign cultural exchange.' So how much Chinese cultural 'substance' did this 'opening the pen' ceremony and Liu Zhipeng actually display? Let me first answer the reader's question: does the ceremony match the traditional Chinese 'opening the pen' ritual? In fact, this so-called opening-the-pen ceremony at Wong Tai Sin Temple is nothing more than a copy of a style of play that has only become popular among mainlanders in the last decade or so; the old Chinese enrollment ceremony wasn't necessarily done this way at all — moreover that was a private-school ritual, and transplanting it into today's Western-style education system just feels affected. As for the actual details of the traditional ceremony, I'm not old enough to have witnessed the old era myself, and relevant documentary records are not common. As far as I know, the most credible and detailed account of the old-style enrollment ceremony is recorded in Wong Chai-lok's 'History of the Development of Chinese Education in Hong Kong.' In the early 20th century, the renowned Hong Kong-Macau private tutor Chan Tsz-po (1862–1922) ran a private school at 31 Caine Road; his student Ho Man-lok orally recounted the old private-school enrollment ceremony to Wong Chai-lok in 1971. The book records the following precious material: 1) Incense and candles were lit before a portrait of Confucius. 2) The teacher first bowed to the portrait and reported the enrolling child's name, age, and native place. 3) The child knelt and bowed to the portrait, then bowed to the teacher. 4) The teacher dipped a brush in cinnabar and dotted the child's forehead, placing a red dot between the eyebrows, symbolizing enlightening and awakening the child. 5) A piece of glutinous rice cake was placed on the seat at the desk, separated by paper, and the child sat briefly on it, symbolizing that the child would always stay close to the desk and study diligently. 6) The teacher took out a copy of the Three Character Classic from a red leather folder on the desk, circled the first few and last few lines in red pen — namely 'At birth, human nature is fundamentally good. Natures are similar; habits make them different,' and 'Make a name for yourself, bring honor to your parents, bring glory to your ancestors, and pass it on to future generations,' and 'I teach my child using only one classic' — and had the child read them aloud. 7) The teacher taught the child to 'open the pen.' On the desk's brush-and-ink tray were the Four Treasures of the Study (paper, ink, brush, inkstone) plus a scallion and a garlic bulb; the teacher held the child's hand and guided it to write a pre-prepared page of red characters: 'Shang Da Ren Kong Yi Ji Hua San Qian Qi Shi Shi' — this was called 'tracing red.' 8) The teacher then spoke a few auspicious words to the child, generally words of blessing, usually four lines. After the auspicious words were spoken, the ceremony was complete. 9) Fruits, cakes and snacks were distributed among the classmates and relatives/friends present. 10) The child carried a lit lantern inscribed with the four characters 'auspicious star shines upon you'...

articles.summary_en: A Hong Kong shrine (Wong Tai Sin Temple) held a modern 'Opening the Pen' ceremony for young children about to start Primary One, dressing them in Confucian-style robes, having them bow to Confucius, write characters, and receive a dot of cinnabar on their forehead. The author, Fung Hei-kin, questions whether this ceremony, which media and a legislator praised as an authentic Chinese tradition, actually reflects genuine old Chinese customs.

articles.title: 受強颱風沙德爾影響　部分來往香港和沖繩航班調整服務
articles.summary: 因為強颱風沙德爾嚟緊，大灣區航空話香港去沖繩嘅班機都會延遲。

levels.text: 因為打颱風沙德爾，大灣區航空話聽日香港去沖繩，同埋沖繩去香港嘅飛機都會遲啲。本來聽朝9點40分去沖繩嘅機，要等到下午1點40分先飛；本來聽日下午2點15分由沖繩飛嚟香港嘅機，就要等到夜晚6點20分先起飛。佢哋話會用短訊或電郵話乘客知，不過天氣仲會變，出發去機場前記得睇清楚班機資料。
levels.text_en: Because of Typhoon Saudel, Greater Bay Airlines says tomorrow's flights from Hong Kong to Okinawa and from Okinawa to Hong Kong will be delayed. The flight to Okinawa originally at 9:40am tomorrow morning will now leave at 1:40pm instead; the flight from Okinawa to Hong Kong originally at 2:15pm tomorrow will now leave at 6:20pm instead. They say they'll notify passengers by text message or email, but the weather may still change, so remember to check the flight details carefully before heading to the airport.

levels.text: 強颱風沙德爾嚟緊，大灣區航空宣布，聽日香港同沖繩之間嘅班機時間會有變動。原本聽朝9時40分由香港飛去沖繩嘅班機HB336，會推遲到下午1時40分先出發；原本聽日下午2時15分由沖繩飛返香港嘅班機HB337，就會推遲到夜晚6時20分先起飛。航空公司話，會用短訊或電郵通知乘客最新嘅航班資訊，不過因為天氣情況隨時會變，班機時間有可能仲會再調整，所以建議乘客出發去機場之前，先睇清楚最新嘅航班狀態。
levels.text_en: With strong Typhoon Saudel approaching, Greater Bay Airlines has announced that tomorrow's flight times between Hong Kong and Okinawa will change. Flight HB336, originally departing Hong Kong for Okinawa at 9:40am tomorrow morning, will be postponed to depart at 1:40pm instead. Flight HB337, originally departing Okinawa for Hong Kong at 2:15pm tomorrow, will be postponed to take off at 6:20pm instead. The airline says it will notify passengers of the latest flight information by text message or email, but since weather conditions could change at any time, flight times may be adjusted further, so passengers are advised to check the latest flight status before heading to the airport.

levels.text: 受強颱風沙德爾影響，大灣區航空宣布，將會調整聽日來往香港同沖繩嘅航班服務。原定聽朝9時40分由香港出發前往沖繩嘅航班HB336，將會延遲至下午1時40分先出發；原定聽日下午2時15分由沖繩出發前往香港嘅航班HB337，就會延遲至夜晚6時20分先起飛。大灣區航空表示，會將最新嘅航班資訊透過短訊或電郵通知乘客，不過由於天氣情況不斷變化，航班有可能需要再作調整，因此建議乘客喺出發前往機場之前，先查閱最新嘅航班狀態，以免影響行程。
levels.text_en: Affected by strong Typhoon Saudel, Greater Bay Airlines has announced it will adjust flight services between Hong Kong and Okinawa tomorrow. Flight HB336, originally scheduled to depart Hong Kong for Okinawa at 9:40am tomorrow morning, will be delayed to depart at 1:40pm instead. Flight HB337, originally scheduled to depart Okinawa for Hong Kong at 2:15pm tomorrow, will be delayed to take off at 6:20pm instead. Greater Bay Airlines states it will notify passengers of the latest flight information via text message or email, but as weather conditions keep changing, flights may need further adjustment. Therefore, passengers are advised to check the latest flight status before heading to the airport, to avoid disruption to their travel plans.

levels.text: 強颱風沙德爾來襲，大灣區航空宣布明天香港與沖繩之間的航班時間有變。原定明天上午9時40分從香港飛往沖繩的HB336航班，將延至下午1時40分起飛。原定明天下午2時15分從沖繩飛往香港的HB337航班，將延至晚上6時20分起飛。航空公司表示會透過短訊和電郵通知乘客最新消息，但天氣仍在變化，航班時間可能再作調整，建議乘客出發前先查看最新航班狀態。

Flight HB336, originally scheduled to depart Hong Kong for Okinawa at 9:40am tomorrow, will be delayed to depart at 1:40pm. Flight HB337, originally scheduled to depart Okinawa for Hong Kong at 2:15pm tomorrow, will be delayed to depart at 6:20pm. The airline says it will notify passengers of the latest updates via text message and email, but as the weather situation is still evolving, flight times may be adjusted further; passengers are advised to check the latest flight status before departure.

articles.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽　港大奪得冠軍
articles.summary: 香港大學喺機械人比賽入面贏咗中大，攞到冠軍。

levels.text: 香港電台同科技園一齊搞咗個機械人比賽，港大同中大都有代表香港出賽。喺十六隊入面，佢哋兩隊都打入決賽，最後港大贏咗中大，攞到冠軍。財政司司長陳茂波去咗開幕禮，同啲隊員傾偈打氣。
levels.text_en: Radio Television Hong Kong and the Science Park together organized a robot competition. HKU and CUHK both had teams representing Hong Kong. Out of sixteen teams, both of them made it to the final, and in the end HKU beat CUHK to win the championship. Financial Secretary Paul Chan went to the opening ceremony and chatted with the team members to cheer them on.

levels.text: 香港電台同香港科技園公司合辦「亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026」，代表香港出賽嘅香港大學同香港中文大學，喺十六支嚟自唔同國家同地區嘅隊伍入面表現出色，兩間大學都打入咗決賽。決賽入面，港大擊敗中大，攞到冠軍。財政司司長陳茂波做開幕禮嘅主禮嘉賓，仲同好多參賽隊伍代表傾偈打氣。佢之後仲喺網誌度話，國家喺人工智能方面發展好快，對香港嘅經濟同金融市場都有好大幫助。
levels.text_en: Radio Television Hong Kong and Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation jointly organized the "Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union Robot Contest 2026." The University of Hong Kong and the Chinese University of Hong Kong, representing Hong Kong, performed excellently among sixteen teams from different countries and regions, and both universities advanced to the final. In the final, HKU defeated CUHK to win the championship. Financial Secretary Paul Chan was the guest of honor at the opening ceremony and chatted with representatives of many participating teams to cheer them on. He later wrote in his blog that the country is developing rapidly in artificial intelligence, which greatly benefits Hong Kong's economy and financial markets.
